Campus & Graduate Hiring Made Smarter
Attract, Assess, and Hire Top Emerging Talent—Securely and at Scale
Hiring fresh graduates or campus recruits is high-stakes. The volumes are large, the timelines tight, and candidate quality varies widely. Traditional hiring methods struggle to scale or detect increasingly sophisticated fraud, from impersonation to AI-generated answers.
Talview’s Campus Hiring Solution, powered by Ivy AI and our Advanced Proctoring Suite, transforms how you identify the best early-career talent—quickly, fairly, and securely.
Meet Ivy AI: Your Always-On Interviewer
Ivy AI is the world’s first intelligent interviewing agent that conducts structured interviews—anytime, anywhere.
Scalable, On-Demand Interviews:
Candidates can complete interviews at their convenience,
nabling you to screen
thousands without scheduling bottlenecks.
Human-Like Interactions:
Ivy listens, asks follow-ups, and evaluates verbal and non-verbal cues, just like a trained interviewer.
Structured & Unbiased:
Every candidate is assessed on the same criteria using Ivy’s proprietary conversation engine, ensuring consistency and fairness.
Actionable Insights:
Get detailed transcripts, competency scores, and behavioral insights post-interview to make confident decisions.
Built-in Protection Against AI-Aided Fraud
In a world where AI is used to game the system, Talview ensures integrity at every step.
Deepfake & Impersonation Detection:
Advanced face match and liveness checks verify candidate identity.
AI Teleprompter Shielding:
Ivy detects scripted and assisted responses through real-time analysis.
Secure Environment Scanning:
Lockdown browser and multi-angle camera views ensure candidates aren’t receiving external help.
Why It’s Perfect for Campus Hiring
Speed Without Compromise:
Slash your screening time while improving quality of hire.
Reach Broader Talent Pools:
Let students participate from anywhere, even with limited bandwidth or devices.
Enhance Employer Brand:
Offer a modern, seamless candidate experience that aligns with how Gen Z expects to engage.
Data-Driven Decisions:
Use Ivy’s insights to compare candidates objectively—no matter the college or background.
Combine With Assessments & Proctoring
Go beyond interviews—assess cognitive ability, communication, and technical skills with our secure testing and remote proctoring:
AI-powered behavioral and aptitude tests
Live or automated remote proctoring
Browser lockdown and anomaly detection
Real-time alerts for suspicious activity
